interval_method: Paired seed bootstrap, percentile 95%, 20000 resamples; each contrast has an independent fixed random stream. Mirrored arms are never independent resampling units.
scope: Reconstructed intervals supersede the three undocumented manuscript intervals. Historical raw data and registered result files remain unchanged.

ii_mirrored_absolute_depth.definition: At update 800, average absolute test-probe allocation over the two mirrored arms within seed; subtract fixed propensity from state-following. Pool the two disjoint 40-seed cohorts.

iv_a_terminal_alignment.definition: At update 400 under x_both, average absolute aligned allocation over the two formed target labels within seed; aligned acquisition/update mean minus crossed mean.

iv_a_acquisition_main_effect.definition: At update 400 under x_both, reference-acquisition minus alternative-acquisition absolute allocation, averaging the two update conditions and formed labels within seed.
